name: AMBIHAIPAHAR, Ashvini (Ash)
research_notes: Initial pass 2026-09-16. Retained all six undated occupations in frozen parliamentary roster. Live handbook is a JavaScript shell; indexed official occupation excerpts corroborate roles but do not add dates/hours.

Important conflicting evidence: UTS primary alumni profile states JD enrolment in 2013, whereas Wikipedia says qualification achieved in 2013. Retain primary enrolment year and leave graduation unknown; do not assign 2013 as start of legal employment.

Indian Link first-person interview (10 September 2024) describes approximately a decade in employment law. That is not an exact, employer-specific or full-time duration and is not apportioned among union/AHA/law-firm jobs.

LinkedIn public search excerpt identifies PSI/Public Services International, Oceania Region, July 2015–2017, but not role, remuneration or hours. Direct profile retrieval failed; retain as follow-up lead only, not proven paid employment. Do not bypass sign-in.

Vinnies employer article confirms regional director in October 2023; Indian Link confirms role in September 2024. Wikipedia June 2023 start retained at month precision with secondary provenance, pending primary appointment confirmation. Neither observation date is silently used as a start/end date; final departure and campaign leave unknown.

Hospitality Legal is reported as AHA NSW's own law firm; 2023 association membership pack calls successor HTA Legal its firm. Do not treat two possibly overlapping AHA/Hospitality Legal titles as independent full-time intervals. Private company legal form alone does not settle codebook treatment of association-controlled work.

Attempts: official biography; UTS alumni/study pages; public professional-profile search; employer/Vinnies articles and annual-publication searches; union and law-firm date/full-time queries; Indian Link interview; association ownership material. Australian Hotelier full-page access returned 402; only public indexed summary used, no bypass.

Next follow-up: dated CV or historical staff pages for Sydney, ANMF NSW, ETU, AHA and Hospitality Legal; verify PSI role and whether paid; Vinnies appointment/cessation; historical university and firm control; leave and overlaps around 2022 council/2023 and 2025 campaigns. Last follow-up 2026-09-16. Advance initial nationwide pass before repeating exhausted searches.
